nodes.name: InvoiceApiApplication
nodes.docs: Boots the invoice API — the Java backend of the same invoice system the invoice-app example serves from TypeScript. Method security is on because the send and cancel endpoints are guarded with @PreAuthorize; scheduling is on for the nightly overdue sweep. Since 1.0.

business.description: The Java backend that runs invoicing.

nodes.name: InvoiceService.send
nodes.docs: Sends an invoice: status check, send stamp, then invoice.sent on the bus for the notifier to email the PDF. See: TaxCalculator#treatmentFor(String). Since 1.0.

branches.business: Only a draft or an already-late invoice may be sent — a paid or cancelled invoice must never reach the customer again.

arms.label: case DRAFT
arms.business: Never sent before: this is the first time it goes out

arms.label: case OVERDUE
arms.business: Already late: sending again is a payment reminder

arms.label: case PAID
arms.business: Nothing left to chase — the customer has already paid

arms.label: try
arms.business: Announce the send so the notifier can email the customer

arms.label: catch
arms.business: If the message bus is down the invoice still counts as sent; the nightly sweep re-announces it

business.description: Locks the amounts, records the send date, and emails the invoice.

business.label: Work out the tax

nodes.name: TaxCalculator.treatmentFor
nodes.docs: Human-readable tax treatment for a country — printed on the invoice PDF and written to the audit log. See: #taxFor(String, long). Since 1.2.

arms.label: default
arms.business: US and the rest of the world: no VAT charged here
